who_we_are.heading: Who We Are
who_we_are.paragraph_1: The Emerging Generation is a nonprofit organization dedicated to empowering immigrant and newcomer youth aged 15–25 as they navigate life in Canada. We believe every young person deserves more than simply settling into a new country, they deserve the opportunity to belong, discover their potential, and become confident leaders in their communities.
who_we_are.paragraph_2: To empower immigrant youth by providing mentorship, life skills, leadership development, wellness support, and meaningful community connections that help them confidently build successful futures in Canada

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.paragraph: To build a Canada where every immigrant and newcomer youth transitions successfully, operates as an influential community leader, and feels a profound sense of cultural belonging.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.paragraph: Our ongoing mission is to cultivate structured environments that support mental and physical health, build professional confidence, and coordinate deep peer networking channels.

founder.name: Stella Orji-Dada
founder.title: Founder & Executive Director
founder.story: Eight years ago, I arrived in Canada with my family, carrying hope for a new beginning. But beneath the excitement was one of the most uncertain seasons of my life. Like many young immigrants, I quickly realized that starting over wasn't easy. Although I wasn't physically alone, I often felt lonely. Everything was unfamiliar. I was learning a new way of life, trying to understand how things worked, searching for opportunities, and hoping to find people who truly understood what I was experiencing. Building genuine friendships didn't happen overnight. In fact, it took nearly two years before I could confidently say, "This person is my friend." Finding meaningful employment was another challenge. Like many newcomers, I faced rejection, uncertainty, and moments of self-doubt. There were days when I questioned whether I would ever truly feel at home. Looking back, I realize that what I needed most wasn't just information, I needed people. I needed community. I needed mentors. I needed someone who could simply say, "I've been where you are, and you're going to be okay." I wished I had a big sister—someone who understood the journey and could walk alongside me as I navigated this new chapter of life. That experience never left me. As the years passed, I had the privilege of working with young people from different backgrounds, and I kept hearing stories that sounded so much like my own. Different countries. Different cultures. But the same questions:
founder.quote:
Where do I belong?"
"Will I ever feel at home?"
"Who can I talk to?
founder.closing_paragraph:
That's when I realized something had to change.
The Emerging Generation was born from that realization.
I didn't create this organization simply to help young immigrants settle in Canada. I created it to ensure they never have to navigate the journey alone.
My vision is to build the kind of community I wish I had when I first arrived, a place where young people find belonging before loneliness, encouragement before discouragement, guidance instead of confusion, and mentors who genuinely care.
At The Emerging Generation, we believe every young immigrant deserves a safe space to grow, meaningful relationships that inspire confidence, and opportunities to become the leaders they were created to be.
Today, I look back with gratitude for my own journey because it gave me a purpose much greater than myself.
If The Emerging Generation can help even one young person feel seen, supported, and confident enough to embrace their future, then every step of my journey has been worth it.
Welcome to The Emerging Generation.
You don't have to navigate this journey alone.

get_involved.heading: Are You Ready to Shape Tomorrow?

why_us.heading: Why The Emerging Generation?
why_us.paragraph: The Emerging Generation exists to walk alongside young people beyond settlement. We provide the support, relationships, and opportunities they need to grow into confident, connected, and purpose-driven leaders. We don't just help young people settle, we help them thrive.

hero.heading: Empowering the Next Generation of Newcomers
hero.paragraph: We are dedicated to designing communities of mentorship, structural leadership programs, and professional pathways for immigrant youth across Canada.

promise.heading: Our Core Commitment
promise.paragraph: We promise to build structures that allow every youth member to feel integrated and validated, matching resources to actual local newcomer demographics.

who_we_serve.heading: Who We Serve
who_we_serve.paragraph:
We serve immigrant and newcomer youth aged 15–25, including:
• International Students
• Permanent Residents
• Refugees
• Protected Persons
• Canadian-born children of immigrant families
• Newcomer youth beginning a new chapter in Canada
